sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Gog, also called Gogmagog or Gigmagog, is a Cornish folkloric figure. This great giant came from Cornwall. The writer Geoffrey of Monmouth placed him in British legend. Gog attacked King Brutus during his inauguration ceremonies. Brutus and his men soundly defeated the giant.

okr.objective: Set out Gog as a Cornish giant who lost his attack on King Brutus.
